Cancer Australia has procured Carbon Creative to develop a comprehensive media plan and implement Phase 6 of the Yarn for Life campaign.
The media plan will include campaign activity for existing Yarn for Life campaign collateral as well as 5 new translated Aboriginal and Torres Strait Islander languages. It will detail ‘above the line’ campaign activities, including 9 video advertisements previously developed to be used on catch up and broadcast TV channels, Aboriginal Health Television Screens, YouTube, and Meta platforms. 14 radio advertisement languages previously developed will be used on Spotify and radio.
The media plan will also include ‘below the line’ activity including organic social media. This includes proposed promotion and communication activities to be undertaken by Cancer Australia throughout the same time as the media campaign reimplementation.
